item.title: Frontline fatigue: What is being done to address Connecticut's nursing shortage?
item.description: Thousands of nurses are leaving the profession due to burnout, workplace violence, and staffing shortages, while the pipeline of new nurses is struggling to keep up.

item.description: Actor Eric Dane, best known for his role as Dr. Mark Sloan ("McSteamy") on ABC's "Grey's Anatomy" has died at the age of 53.

item.title: Choate alum Hilary Knight leads United States women's hockey team to victory, beating Canada in overtime 2-1
item.description: MILAN (AP) — The United States won its third Olympic gold medal in women's hockey Thursday, beating Canada 2-1 after Megan Keller scored in overtime. The teams went to overtime after Team USA captain Hilary Knight tied the game 1-all. Knight attended Choate Rosemary Hall in Wallingford. This is her fifth Winter Olympic Games.

item.title: Shelter in place lifted as Fairfield police apprehend suspects allegedly tied to home invasion, armed robbery
item.description: A shelter in place order has been lifted as Fairfield police said they've apprehended all the suspects believed involved in an alleged armed robbery and home invasion early Thursday morning.
